title: Movix v2.1.6 - Multi-Audio Stream Engine & Direct OTA
changelog: True Regional Multi-Audio Engine: Server 1 (VidLink Pro Multi-Audio) set as default with direct regional dubbed audio support
Unblocked Player Audio Controls: Direct click-through to internal audio track switcher without overlay interference
Elevated Quick Mirror Bar: Clean bottom spacing so video player controls, gears, and track options are 100% accessible
Strict Movie Language Filtering: Only genuinely available audio tracks for each movie are shown
Instant In-App Direct OTA Updates: High-speed multi-mirror background package download & direct installation
100% Zero-Overlay Cinema Playback: All options, controls, and pills are completely hidden while movie plays
True Edge-to-Edge Fullscreen Playback: Adaptive display cutout support across notch, punch-hole, and curved displays
